manifest.description: Sits in front of Claude Code and fixes the brief before the code. An interview scores how vague your request is, and a score above the bar blocks spec generation until you pass force explicitly. When an acceptance criterion defines a verify command or an expected-output assertion, those values are omitted from the worker's contract block, with no flag to put them back, so the worker is asked for the outcome rather than handed the assertion. Redaction of those values elsewhere is literal over five encodings, so a reshaped copy can still get through; that gap is tracked in a public issue.
manifest.name: ouroboros

hooks.command:
ROOT="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -z "$ROOT" ]; then printf '%s
' 'Ouroboros hook skipped: plugin root is unavailable.' >&2; exit 0; fi; SCRIPT="$ROOT/scripts/drift-monitor.py"; if [ ! -r "$SCRIPT" ]; then printf '%s
' "Ouroboros hook skipped: $SCRIPT is unavailable." >&2; exit 0; fi; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then PYTHON=python3; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then PYTHON=python; else printf '%s
' 'Ouroboros hook skipped: Python is unavailable.' >&2; exit 0; fi; "$PYTHON" "$SCRIPT" || { STATUS=$?; printf '%s
' "Ouroboros hook failed open: $SCRIPT exited with code $STATUS." >&2; exit 0; }
hooks.commandWindows: try { $OutputEncoding=[Console]::InputEncoding=[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); $root=$env:PLUGIN_ROOT; if (!$root) { $root=$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (!$root) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Ouroboros hook skipped: plugin root is unavailable.'); exit 0 }; $script=Join-Path -Path $root -ChildPath 'scripts/drift-monitor.py' -ErrorAction Stop; if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $script -PathType Leaf)) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Ouroboros hook skipped: '+$script+' is unavailable.'); exit 0 }; foreach ($name in @('python','python3')) { $python=Get-Command $name -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (!$python) { continue }; try { $executable=& $python.Source -X utf8 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(1) if sys.version_info.major != 3 else print(sys.executable)' 2>$null } catch { continue }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $executable -isnot [string]) { continue }; if (![System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($executable) -or [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($executable) -ne '.exe' -or !(Test-Path -LiteralPath $executable -PathType Leaf)) { continue }; & $executable -X utf8 $script; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Ouroboros hook failed open: '+$script+' exited with code '+$LASTEXITCODE+'.') }; exit 0 }; [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Ouroboros hook skipped: Python 3 is unavailable.') } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Ouroboros hook failed open: '+$_.Exception.Message) }; exit 0
